title: Intraday momentum, volume-shock momentum, daily crash reversal (3 trials)

trials.A intraday momentum (Wen et al. 2022): BTC and ETH: sign of the 00:00-01:00 UTC bar's return -> position 0.5 x sign held during the 23:00-24:00 UTC bar of the same day
trials.B volume-shock momentum: 60 coins, daily: quote volume z vs its own 90 days (lagged) > 3 -> position 0.1 x sign(that day's return) for the next 3 days (at most 8 open)
trials.C daily crash reversal: 60 coins, daily: a day's return below -3 x the coin's 90-day daily sd (lagged) -> long 0.1 for the next 3 days (at most 8 open)

bars: DEV (2020-22) > 0, TEST >= 0.8, HOLD >= 0.5, |corr v8.6| <= 0.2, |corr premium-spike sleeve| <= 0.5
